# INSURANCE-PLAN

> Every page of the INSURANCE-PLAN module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [Insurance plan](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-122/docs/nhcx/v1/api/insurance-plan): The Insurance plan calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Payer: send the insurance plan](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-122/docs/nhcx/v1/api/insurance-plan/endpoints/insurance-plan-v1-insuranceplan-on-request): Payer returns the InsurancePlan collection Bundle (InsurancePlan, Organisation, optional Questionnaire) under the request correlation ID.
- [Provider: request an insurance plan](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-122/docs/nhcx/v1/api/insurance-plan/endpoints/insurance-plan-v1-insuranceplan-request): Provider sends a Task with code poll naming both a policy number and its HFR ID to fetch the payer's machine-readable InsurancePlan for that pairing.
- [Provider receives the insurance plan](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-122/docs/nhcx/v1/api/insurance-plan/endpoints/insurance-plan-webhook-v1-insuranceplan-on-request): Hosted by the provider. The exchange posts this message to the endpoint_url you registered, at /v1/insuranceplan/on_request, with the headers and the sealed...
- [Payer receives an insurance plan request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-122/docs/nhcx/v1/api/insurance-plan/endpoints/insurance-plan-webhook-v1-insuranceplan-request): Hosted by the payer. The exchange posts this message to the endpoint_url you registered, at /v1/insuranceplan/request, with the headers and the sealed...
- [Insurance plan errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-122/docs/nhcx/v1/api/insurance-plan/errors): What Insurance plan returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
